sourceFacts: rp1.dtsi maps rp1_clocks at RP1 bus 0xc040018000, accepted as CPU physical 0x1f00018000.
clk-rp1.c defines CLK_ADC_CTRL at offset 0x00144 and CLK_CTRL_ENABLE as bit 11.
Linux rp1_clock_on/off modify CLK_CTRL_ENABLE on the clock's own ctrl_reg.
GPCLK output-enable writes are guarded by oe_mask; clk_adc has no oe_mask.
rp1.dtsi marks the ADC consumer node disabled.

findings.summary: Selected one non-idempotent but bounded transition on the accepted CLK_ADC_CTRL register.
Defined transition_raw as pre_raw XOR CLK_CTRL_ENABLE so only the source-defined enable bit may change.
Required pre-state reporting before transition write, immediate restore-write of pre_raw, and restore-read equality.
Retained source evidence isolating clk_adc from GPCLK output-enable, boot UART, critical clocks, GPIO14/GPIO16, interrupt routing, PCIe/RP1 access, and reset-controller paths.
Broad clock/reset ownership, reset-controller operations, GPIO ownership, event generation, interrupt delivery, and handler ownership require later supervisor planning.
The prior 0xdeaddead raw value is retained only as prior-run raw evidence, not a broad decoded state claim.
